messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a maintenance window tonight 23:00-02:00 UTC to roll out model-serving v2.3. Need status page update + customer emails. Tentative: canary first, then fleet. Any blockers?

ashwin: quick q — do we need to pin dedicated customers to v2.2 during the rollout? A few requested strict versioning.

taylor: agree with pinning for SLA customers. We can include that in the change window comms.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued by maria. Canary (region: eu-west-1) scheduled 23:15 UTC. Plan: build -> smoke -> canary -> gradual. Will notify @sre-oncall on failures.

maria: yes, pin customers who asked. @support-ops can you prepare the comms? :pray:

support-ops: working on a short statuspage blurb + email template. Draft below.

support-ops: [statuspage draft]
Scheduled maintenance: rolling update to the inference runtime (v2.3) to improve latency and batching. Expected impact: possible brief degradation (<=5m) during canary/failover. Window: 23:00-02:00 UTC. Updates will follow.

support-ops: [email draft]
Subject: Planned maintenance: inference platform update — 23:00 UTC
Body: Hi — we will perform scheduled maintenance to deploy performance improvements (v2.3). We expect minimal disruption; we'll update you if anything changes. Link to status page and migration guide included.

jonah: please add a line linking SDK migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/v2.3-migrations 

sre-oncall: monitoring hooks in place. Per rollback policy: if canary error-rate >= 3% sustained for 10m -> auto-rollback to v2.2. Comfortable with that threshold?

ashwin: threshold looks fine. Add a note on statuspage about "possible transient increased latency" so customers are pre-warned.

taylor: approved. @maria greenlight?

maria: greenlight. Support — post initial statuspage 30m before window and send customer email 15m before.

deploy-bot: Canary started 23:15 UTC — smoke tests passing. Rolling to 10% traffic.

support-ops: statuspage scheduled (posted as scheduled incident) — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/SE-123

deploy-bot: Canary reached 10% traffic -> error-rate spike 4.2% at ~23:27 UTC. Auto-rollback triggered per policy. Rollback initiated.

sre-oncall: seeing spike in 23:26-23:28. Initiating rollback now and opening an incident ticket.

maria: thanks. Support, update statuspage to reflect rollback and ETA for resolution. Mark as investigating. :warning:

support-ops: updated statuspage: "Investigating: canary rollback due to elevated errors. Rollback in progress. No customer data impact reported."

support-ops: queued customer update draft:
"Hi — during tonight's scheduled deployment we observed elevated error rates during canary and performed an automatic rollback to v2.2 at 23:33 UTC. No customer data impact. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline and mitigations."

ashwin: capturing relevant logs & traces, tagging incident SE-123. Also collecting which dedicated tenants saw routing changes so we can notify them specifically.

jonah: adding a rollback note to the release notes and linking the migration guide + incident ticket.

taylor: who will own postmortem?

maria: assign to ashwin + jonah for root cause and mitigation. @sre-oncall to lead monitoring follow-up and alert tuning.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 23:33 UTC. Canary cluster stable on v2.2.

sre-oncall: confirming telemetry back to baseline. We'll run an extended staging test tomorrow and try a smaller canary next week (5% -> 20%).

support-ops: posted 'resolved' update to statuspage at 23:50 UTC and sent customer emails with the timeline and follow-up promise.

maria: thanks everyone. Final action items: update release notes to reflect rollback + planned retest, pin affected dedicated customers to v2.2 until we have a validated patch, and schedule a 1h postmortem sync tomorrow.

support-ops: adding final comms templates to the incident doc. Example statuspage API call we used:
```
curl -X POST https://status.redwood.ai/api/incidents \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${STATUS_API_KEY}' \\n  -d '{"incident":{"name":"Canary rollback - v2.3","status":"investigating","body":"Rollback performed at 23:33 UTC. No data impact."}}'
```

ashwin: will attach relevant logs to SE-123 and tag customers for targeted emails.

maria: good job on fast rollback and clear comms. We'll iterate on canary health checks and maybe tighten the smoke test to catch this earlier. :thumbsup:
